SMTO-SKL-0129 — Slack won't let SMTO edit that message

GUID: 73e2af6a-7f83-51b0-bca6-4d4c2f65b7b0
Slug: slack-cannot-edit-message
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • Slack refused to edit the message. Usually the connected account didn't write it, or your workspace no longer allows edits after a set time. The message was not changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In Slack, check who posted the message. SMTO can only edit messages written by the account or bot it's connected as. Slack doesn't let one account edit another person's message.
  2. Check whether the message is older than your workspace's edit time limit. If it is, post a new message or correction instead. Slack blocks edits after that limit, and SMTO can't override it.
  3. Look at the message's current text in Slack before asking the Agent to edit it again. Checking first makes sure you don't overwrite a change someone else made.

What success looks like

  • Slack shows the message with your new text, or you've posted a correction instead.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to your Slack workspace admin, who controls the editing rules. Don't keep asking the Agent to retry the same edit; Slack will refuse it the same way.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Slack returned cant_update_message or edit_window_closed for chat.update on the exact channel_id and ts.

What this means

  • Slack returns cant_update_message or edit_window_closed. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Slack returns cant_update_message or edit_window_closed.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect message ownership and the recorded provider reason before changing content.

How to fix it

  • Confirm the message author matches the profile's user_id or bot_user_id and that the workspace's message-editing policy still allows the edit; read the current message with slack.message before any deliberate new slack.update_message.
  • Verify the selected principal owns the exact message and Slack permits editing; inspect current text before another attempt.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The exact intended edit is permitted by ownership and workspace policy.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
